correctness.rationale: For every outside vertex in part i, the fort condition is exactly |F|-f_i != 1. This gives the complete minimal-fort classification, from which the count formulas are direct. The matching formula is proved by an exchange normalization for triple forts and a parity-leftover argument. The fractional formula is forced by all pair constraints and attained by explicit half-weight assignments. An independent exhaustive checker confirms the hypergraph, maximum matching, and LP value through order ten.

value.rationale: Minimal forts are the irredundant constraints in fort-cover zero-forcing formulations and define both fort number and fractional zero forcing. The complete multipartite family is canonical, and its hypergraph changes qualitatively beyond the bipartite case by acquiring size-three transversal edges. The theorem resolves the full minimal-fort structure, exact count, maximum disjoint-fort matching, and fractional transversal number in closed form.
